units.source_text: 然而，岛村来到客栈门口，抬眼一望散发出浓烈嫩叶气息的后山，

en.t: However, when Shimamura came to the inn entrance and looked up at the mountain behind it, thick with the scent of fresh young leaves,

units.source_text: 就被吸引住了，随即冒冒失失地只顾自己登山去了。

en.t: he was drawn to it and at once, rashly thinking only of himself, went climbing up the mountain.
